title: Narrow at Threshold, Broader with Strength

scenes.tts: Does each taste fibre carry one taste, or must the brain read a pattern across many fibres?
scenes.visual: Title card: Narrow at Threshold, Broader with Strength. Then a bundle of fibres leaving a taste bud. Question on screen: one taste per fibre?
scenes.narration: Does each taste fibre carry one taste, or must the brain read a pattern across many fibres?

scenes.tts: If each fibre listened only to cells of one taste, it would be a labelled line. Its activity would mean one taste.
scenes.visual: Three fibres, each wired to one coloured population labelled sweet cells, bitter cells and sour cells; each fibre tagged with one taste. Label: labelled line.
scenes.narration: If each fibre listened only to cells of one taste, it would be a labelled line. Its activity would mean one taste.

scenes.tts: In anaesthetized mice, Barretto and colleagues imaged geniculate ganglion neurons while tastants flowed over the tongue.
scenes.visual: Rows of ganglion neurons; a lens above them; neurons flash as a tastant label scrolls past. On-screen: Barretto and colleagues, 2015.
scenes.narration: In anaesthetized mice, Barretto and colleagues imaged geniculate ganglion neurons while tastants flowed over the tongue.

scenes.tts: Most responding neurons were strongly activated by only one of the tested tastes.
scenes.visual: Most flashing neurons light in a single colour, one taste each.
scenes.narration: Most responding neurons were strongly activated by only one of the tested tastes.

scenes.tts: One class did not fit. Some neurons responded to both bitter and sour.
scenes.visual: One neuron highlighted, flashing for both bitter and sour.
scenes.narration: One class did not fit. Some neurons responded to both bitter and sour.

scenes.tts: Two ideas. Maybe the neuron gets input from both sour and bitter cells.
scenes.visual: Diagram A: two wires, one from a sour cell and one from a bitter cell, converging on the neuron. Label: convergence.
scenes.narration: Two ideas. Maybe the neuron gets input from both sour and bitter cells.

scenes.tts: Or it listens only to bitter cells, and acid also activates them.
scenes.visual: Diagram B: one wire from a bitter cell; both a bitter molecule and an acid drop act on that cell. Label: one cell, two chemicals.
scenes.narration: Or it listens only to bitter cells, and acid also activates them.

scenes.tts: The authors silenced the sour cells. Under each idea, what should happen to the bitter-sour neurons?
scenes.visual: Both diagrams side by side; the sour cell in diagram A is greyed out with a silencing symbol. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: The authors silenced the sour cells. Under each idea, what should happen to the bitter-sour neurons?

scenes.tts: Sour-only responses disappeared. But the bitter-sour class was still there.
scenes.visual: Sour-only neurons go dark. The highlighted bitter-sour neuron keeps flashing for both. Diagram A is crossed out.
scenes.narration: Sour-only responses disappeared. But the bitter-sour class was still there.

scenes.tts: And when bitter responses were blocked instead, the bitter-sour class disappeared.
scenes.visual: Second test: the bitter cell is blocked; the bitter-sour neuron goes dark.
scenes.narration: And when bitter responses were blocked instead, the bitter-sour class disappeared.

scenes.tts: So the authors concluded that acid drives these neurons through bitter cells. For these neurons, the fibre reports the cell, not the chemical.
scenes.visual: Diagram B is ticked. Label: for these bitter-sour neurons, the fibre reports which cell population is active, not which chemical is on the tongue.
scenes.narration: So the authors concluded that acid drives these neurons through bitter cells. For these neurons, the fibre reports the cell, not the chemical.

scenes.tts: Now the counter-weight. Wu and colleagues compared low and higher concentrations. Tuning broadened as concentration rose.
scenes.visual: On-screen: Wu and colleagues, 2015, anaesthetized mice. A concentration slider moves from low to high.
scenes.narration: Now the counter-weight. Wu and colleagues compared low and higher concentrations. Tuning broadened as concentration rose.

scenes.tts: Of the neurons tested at both strengths, most became more broadly tuned at the higher one.
scenes.visual: As the slider moves, more neurons flash for two or more tastes. Counter on screen: 35 of 41 neurons broadened.
scenes.narration: Of the neurons tested at both strengths, most became more broadly tuned at the higher one.

scenes.tts: So narrow or broad? Imaging usually calls a neuron responsive when its signal crosses a fixed threshold.
scenes.visual: A bar chart for one neuron with a horizontal dashed line labelled threshold, 0.25.
scenes.narration: So narrow or broad? Imaging usually calls a neuron responsive when its signal crosses a fixed threshold.

scenes.tts: Picture a neuron with a full input from its main cell type, and a weak one from a second.
scenes.visual: Two bars: main input, weight 1; second input, weight 0.4.
scenes.narration: Picture a neuron with a full input from its main cell type, and a weak one from a second.

scenes.tts: Each input saturates as concentration rises. These numbers are made up, to show the logic.
scenes.visual: A small saturating curve: activation 0.33 at low concentration, 0.89 at high. Label: illustrative, not data.
scenes.narration: Each input saturates as concentration rises. These numbers are made up, to show the logic.

scenes.tts: At low strength, does the weak input cross the threshold? And at high strength?
scenes.visual: Slider at low. Both bars visible below and above the line; the question on screen.
scenes.narration: At low strength, does the weak input cross the threshold? And at high strength?

scenes.tts: At low strength, the main input crosses, and the weak one stays below. The neuron looks narrow.
scenes.visual: Low: main bar at 0.33, over the line; second bar at 0.13, under it. Label: looks narrow.
scenes.narration: At low strength, the main input crosses, and the weak one stays below. The neuron looks narrow.

scenes.tts: At high strength, the weak input climbs past the line. The same neuron now looks broad.
scenes.visual: Slider moves to high: second bar rises to 0.36, past the line. Label: looks broad.
scenes.narration: At high strength, the weak input climbs past the line. The same neuron now looks broad.

scenes.tts: In this model, a weak input of weight zero point two never reaches the threshold of zero point two five. Whenever the main response crosses that threshold, the neuron responds to one taste in this panel only.
scenes.caption: In this model, a weak input of weight 0.2 never reaches the threshold of 0.25. Whenever the main response crosses that threshold, the neuron responds to one taste in this panel only.
scenes.visual: A second neuron: weak input of weight 0.2; even at full activation its bar tops out at 0.2, below the 0.25 line. Label: illustrative model.
scenes.narration: In this model, a weak input of weight 0.2 never reaches the threshold of 0.25. Whenever the main response crosses that threshold, the neuron responds to one taste in this panel only.

scenes.tts: So in the model, neurons with different weak inputs differ. Some broaden and some do not. Wu found most broadened, but not all.
scenes.visual: Many model neurons, each with a different weak-input bar; most cross at high strength, a few never do. Label: illustrative model. Counter beside it: 35 of 41 broadened (data).
scenes.narration: So in the model, neurons with different weak inputs differ. Some broaden and some do not. Wu found most broadened, but not all.

scenes.tts: Those data fit the model, but they do not show which neurons have weak inputs.
scenes.visual: The counter stays; the model bars dim. Label: compatible, not proof.
scenes.narration: Those data fit the model, but they do not show which neurons have weak inputs.

scenes.tts: If responses were counted against the neuron's own best, and all inputs rose alike, breadth would not change.
scenes.visual: The fixed line is replaced by a line drawn at a fraction of each neuron's tallest bar; both bars grow together and the count stays flat.
scenes.narration: If responses were counted against the neuron's own best, and all inputs rose alike, breadth would not change.

scenes.tts: So narrow depends on the panel, the concentration and the criterion. The two laboratories' results need not conflict.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: narrow depends on the stimulus panel, the concentration range and the criterion for calling a response.
scenes.narration: So narrow depends on the panel, the concentration and the criterion. The two laboratories' results need not conflict.
